paper_title: Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative   Reward Model Based Simulated User
caption: The performance changes with respect to the depth of search. As a reference, we add the performance of ReFICR.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the performance metrics for a system called "ReDial," comparing Recall@50 and NDCG@50 for two different methods (Ours and ReFICR). The x-axis represents an index from 1 to 5 on a linear scale, with integer tick intervals. The primary y-axis on the left is labeled "Recall@50," ranging from 0.30 to 0.60, also on a linear scale, with intervals of 0.05. The secondary y-axis on the right is labeled "NDCG@50," ranging from 0.15 to 0.22 with intervals of 0.01. The solid green line with circular markers represents "Recall@50 (Ours)," starting at 0.35 at x=1 and increasing steadily to approximately 0.48 at x=5. The dotted green line represents "Recall@50 (ReFICR)," remaining constant at approximately 0.46 across all x values. The solid blue line with square markers signifies "NDCG@50 (Ours)," beginning at approximately 0.16 at x=1 and rising to just below 0.195 by x=5. Meanwhile, the blue dotted line for "NDCG@50 (ReFICR)" stays constant at 0.155.A legend positioned near the top-left of the plot defines each line by its corresponding model information, marker shape and color.
